name: Sign
description: Multiple signs appear throughout the narrative. In the community radio studio, an ON AIR sign flickers and eventually steadies into a solid red glow. At the high school gym shelter, handwritten signs point toward MEDICINE, MEALS, and MESSAGES on a whiteboard. June tapes a new sign over the studio door reading OPEN FREQUENCY. Additionally, Maya brings a flyer for a missing dog named Comet that functions as an informational sign.
narrative_significance: Signs serve as critical communication tools during the emergency. The ON AIR sign represents the operational status of the community radio station—the lifeline for disaster information and coordination. The directional signs at the shelter organize emergency services and resources. The OPEN FREQUENCY sign signals the station's commitment to public service. Together, these signs embody the theme of communication and community coordination during crisis.
